# Progress ring: `jl-progress-ring`

A ring that shows how much of a task is done, for small places.

- Class `JlProgressRing`, an atom: `import { JlProgressRing } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/progress-ring

The circular progress fits where a bar has no room: a card's corner, a table cell, a button, a list
row. With show-value, the percentage sits in its centre (from about 40 pixels).

Without a value it turns: the work has no known end. Name it with label, for screen readers.

## Use

```ts
import { JlProgressRing } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlProgressRing showValue size={64} thickness={6} value={62} />
```

```html
<jl-progress-ring show-value size="64" thickness="6" value="62"></jl-progress-ring>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `value` (attribute `value`): `number | null`, default `null`. How much is done, out of max. Without it, the ring turns.
- `max` (attribute `max`): `number`, default `100`. The value of a finished task.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `number`, default `40`. The width and height, in pixels.
- `thickness` (attribute `thickness`): `number`, default `4`. The width of the stroke, in pixels.
- `tone` (attribute `tone`): `'accent' | 'ok' | 'warn' | 'danger'`, default `'accent'`. The colour of the arc.
- `showValue` (attribute `show-value`): `boolean`, default `false`. Prints the percentage in the centre.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. Its name for screen readers ("Progress" when empty).

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The ring and its percentage.
- `--color` (custom property): The colour of the arc, beyond the tones.
- `--track` (custom property): The colour of the track under the arc.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Values

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-progress-ring value="25"></jl-progress-ring>
  <jl-progress-ring value="50"></jl-progress-ring>
  <jl-progress-ring value="75"></jl-progress-ring>
  <jl-progress-ring value="100" tone="ok"></jl-progress-ring>
</div>
```

### Sizes and value

Any size and thickness, in pixels; the percentage in the centre.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-progress-ring value="62" size="16" thickness="2.5" label="Syncing"></jl-progress-ring>
  <jl-progress-ring value="62" size="24" thickness="3"></jl-progress-ring>
  <jl-progress-ring value="62" size="48" show-value></jl-progress-ring>
  <jl-progress-ring value="62" size="72" thickness="6" show-value></jl-progress-ring>
  <jl-progress-ring value="62" size="96" thickness="8" show-value></jl-progress-ring>
</div>
```

### Tones

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-progress-ring value="70" size="48" show-value></jl-progress-ring>
  <jl-progress-ring value="70" size="48" tone="ok" show-value></jl-progress-ring>
  <jl-progress-ring value="70" size="48" tone="warn" show-value></jl-progress-ring>
  <jl-progress-ring value="70" size="48" tone="danger" show-value></jl-progress-ring>
</div>
```

### Indeterminate

No value: it turns.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-progress-ring size="20" thickness="2.5" label="Loading"></jl-progress-ring>
  <jl-progress-ring label="Loading"></jl-progress-ring>
</div>
```

### In a card

A quota at a glance, beside what it measures.

```html
<jl-card class="narrow" heading="Storage" description="4.2 GB of 5 GB used">
  <jl-progress-ring slot="actions" value="84" size="44" tone="warn" show-value label="Storage used"></jl-progress-ring>
  <span class="muted">Free some space or upgrade before the end of the month.</span>
</jl-card>
```
